case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

On the cost side, you pointed to copper, labour and the converter producer index. On the price outlook:
Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our order history with you:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 414.58; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 415.97; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It pairs the binding volume with a unit price in line with our recent orders, and with a payment term that stays close to the standard.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Option A gives Selvbrunn Drive Systems a firm volume commitment and a stable, predictable frame agreement. It can be approved as it stands.

Please take Option A to the approver. If the committee needs anything further to decide, tell us what it requires and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your order history and acknowledge the forecasted volume increase. However, as to the price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

This concession reflects the value of the extended commitment, as we are currently unable to reduce prices without corresponding adjustments to the terms. In exchange for extending the contract term to 24 months and adjusting the payment to 45 days net, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 429.43. Specifically, an alternative package provides a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and the options below answer that: every one of them carries a binding volume over a longer contract term, which gives you the planning certainty you described. We are not asking you to move against your price freeze, so we are meeting you on the other terms you named.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 421.26; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 413.17; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 5,496 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.38; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you the binding volume and the longer term you asked for, and it reflects the delivery record above. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, here is a paragraph you can forward unchanged:

Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers a binding volume for the 7.5 kW frequency converter over a longer contract term, under Option A. This gives Selvbrunn secured volume and a longer-term commitment without a price reduction.

Could you take Option A to the approver? If the committee needs anything further to decide, please tell me and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer provides a price of €426.97 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

As to the delivery record data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have verified the delivery record you cited; however, our management's price freeze remains in effect.

We appreciate your willingness to increase the binding volume to 5,496 units per year over a 24-month contract. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? In exchange for this higher volume and a payment term of 60 days net, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 424.61. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a volume of 5496 pcs per year: €424.61 per unit.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.
